description: Implementation of the CategoryDao interface, providing database access methods for Category entities using QueryDSL and JPA, including retrieval by name, URL, code, IDs, lineage, depth, parent, and store.

classes.name: CategoryDaoImpl
classes.description: A DAO implementation class for managing Category entities, extending generic DAO functionality and providing custom queries for categories.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories matching a specific name within a merchant store and language.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Lists categories filtered by SEO URL within a merchant store.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Fetches a single category matching a specific SEO URL within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its code within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByCodes
methods.description: Retrieves multiple categories by a list of codes within a merchant store and specified language.

methods.name: getByIds
methods.description: Retrieves multiple categories by a list of IDs within a merchant store and specified language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its ID and language.

methods.name: getByCode (overload)
methods.description: Retrieves a category based on merchant store code and category code.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its ID.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories matching a lineage pattern within a merchant store.

methods.name: listByLineage (overload)
methods.description: Lists categories matching a lineage pattern within a merchant store specified by store code.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories at a specific depth level within a merchant store.

methods.name: listByDepth (with language)
methods.description: Lists categories at a specific depth level within a merchant store, filtered by language.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists child categories of a given parent category filtered by language.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories in a store filtered by parent category.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories within a merchant store.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Counts products associated with each given category ID within a store, considering availability and date.

methods.name: listByStore (with language)
methods.description: Lists categories within a store filtered by language.
